title: Bay key returned to an occupied load
body: The bay key is clipped to a dispatch tag marked returned. The lunchbox beside it still contains a warm-looking wrapper and a pass reading load inside. The release line is unsigned.
rival_reading: A farm shipment could have had its key returned before a dispatch was updated; an unsigned release line does not establish that an evacuation failed.
gloss: A returned bay key lies beside a pass saying the load remains inside.

title: The receiving page stayed dry
body: The notebook lists water for three field rows. The bucket is dry, with a smear of pale powder around its handle; the receiving page says ‘awaiting sample.’ A worker has drawn a door on the margin.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could list water for a response route before receiving it; a dry bucket and a delayed sample do not prove a program malfunction.
gloss: A field-water list and an awaiting sample remain with a dry, marked bucket.
